title: Staged Feature-Gate & Compatibility Escrow Plan for Legacy Model Tags
creator: Priya Shah
description: Plan to retire legacy model tags (legacy-v1/*) behind a staged feature gate with an escrow compatibility layer. Goal: give customers a predictable migration runway, automated compatibility checks, clear release notes, and a rollback path. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, DX, Legal, and GTM for launch and post-launch monitoring.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Compatibility escrow service deployed to staging and smoke-tested against 50 customer-like payloads. 2) Migration guide and quickstart published in Docs with code samples. 3) Release notes approved by Legal & Support. 4) Communication cadence scheduled with top 30 high-usage customers. 5) Canary rollout to 5% hosted traffic with rollback tested.
migration_steps: Inventory: generate list of customers using legacy-v1 tags and export usage patterns (eng dashboard link).
Compatibility escrow: implement shim that translates legacy tag calls to new model variants and logs mismatches in structured format.
Automated checks: add nightly regression tests using canonical prompt-suite to verify parity within tolerance thresholds.
Docs: publish migration guide, sample curl/SDK snippets, and compatibility FAQ in Docs site.
Deprecation notice: send staged email sequence + console banner + API header deprecation warning per timeline below.
Canary: enable escrow for 5% traffic, monitor errors & latency for 72 hours, then expand if stable.
Rollout: incrementally disable legacy tags over 8-week runway; escrow available for 12 months post-disable.
Sunset: final removal date and archive policy communicated 30 days prior.
go_to_market_tasks: Draft customer comms templates: initial notice, migration checklist, final sunset reminder.
Publish release notes page and changelog entry with explicit migration links.
Prepare support playbook and troubleshooting KB for top-10 migration issues.
Coordinate with Solutions and Sales for outreach to enterprise customers with usage > $5k/mo.
Update Self-Serve in-app flows: migration assistant, auto-detection of legacy tags and offer one-click migration where possible.
Schedule AMA with customers (Office Hours) in two weeks after first notice.
comms_timeline: T-28 days: Publish public doc + initial deprecation notice via console banner and email digest.
T-21 days: Release notes published; post on status.redwood.com and community forum.
T-14 days: Customer outreach by Solutions for top 30 accounts; offer migration assistance.
T-7 days: In-app migration prompts and guided walkthroughs go live.
T+0 day (disable): Turn on compatibility escrow and begin canary traffic routing (5%).
T+7 days: Canary review; if stable, expand to 25%.
T+30 days: Final sunset reminder for customers who have not migrated.
T+90 days: Escrow remains as fallback for high-impact customers by request; plan for phased removal communicated.
rollback_plan: If parity regressions or customer-facing errors exceed thresholds (error > 0.5% or latency P95 regression > 150ms), immediately revert routing for affected customers to pre-change state, re-enable legacy tag handling inline, and open P0 incident with SRE, Eng, and PM. After revert, run deeper analysis, patch escrow shim, and reattempt canary following mitigation checklist.
metrics_and_signals: Migration adoption rate (percentage of customers migrated by week)
API error rate for legacy-tagged requests (goal < 0.2%)
Avg and P95 latency delta for escrow vs native (goal < +80ms)
Model output regression score on canonical prompt-suite (goal: < 2% quality delta)
Support ticket volume related to model differences or authentication changes
Top-affected customers and revenue-at-risk dashboard link
